name: Default
shortDescription: Plex Media Server for organizing and streaming movies, shows, music and photos to Plex apps and the web player.

alerts.message: Set PLEX_CLAIM to a claim token from plex.tv/claim right before deploying; it expires after 4 minutes. Without it the server cannot be signed in to your Plex account from the public domain. If it expired, set a fresh one and redeploy.
